subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Methyltrioxorhenium（MeReO₃）？
A. Tetrahedral
B. Square planar
C. Trigonal planar
D. Linear
explanation: Tetrahedral. Covalent count: Re (group 7) 7 e; 1 × Me (X) 1 e; 3 × O (X₂) 6 e: 14 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −7 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Re(VII), d⁰; d⁰ + 14 e from the ligands = 14 e. MTO. Counting each oxo as X2; π-donation from O would add more.
